diagnostics.method: First-order Rusanov finite-volume fluxes; shared-corner constrained transport; SSP RK2; CFL/diffusion/reaction limits with rejected positivity steps. Numerical diffusion is present and must be tested by refinement.
diagnostics.criteria: Periodic global mass and total MHD energy relative residual<1e-8; normalized staggered divergence<1e-10; finite positive density/pressure/material temperature. Passing is numerical consistency, not empirical validation.

presentation.units: dimensionless display coordinates; independent of SI electromagnetic model
presentation.positionOrdering: [display X, axial display height, display Z]
presentation.interpolation: periodic bilinear interpolation of Re psi and Im psi at every mesh vertex; geometry and RGB use the same complex value there
presentation.surfaceBetweenVertices: piecewise-linear triangle positions and perspective-correct barycentric RGB interpolation; no claim of exact nonlinear field evaluation per fragment
presentation.lighting: unlit; stored RGB is the actual fixed-amplitude phase encoding
presentation.color: HSV hue=(arg(psi)+pi)/(2*pi), saturation=.76, value=clamp(abs(psi),0,1); dark undefined phase if amplitude <=1e-10
presentation.physicalScope: Stored 2D neutral complex Ginzburg–Landau field displayed on a cylinder; no 3D cylindrical physical evolution
